title: (0Day) OpenAI Codex Sandbox Escape Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass the sandbox on affected installations of OpenAI Codex. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must use Codex to process a repository containing malicious JavaScript. The specific flaw exists within the JavaScript execution environment. The issue results from the lack of proper isolation of the sandboxed context. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass the sandbox and execute code in the context of the current user.
